chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, All Streams Flow to the Sea, and Water's Edge on Seapunk, then Coral Guard. This spends all 3 Energy, deals 25 damage, and gains 5 Block against the incoming 11 damage.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing Water's Edge with a second Coral Guard, dealing 19 damage while gaining 10 Block and taking only 1 unblocked damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 5 additional Block, so it takes 6 unblocked damage instead of 1, in exchange for 6 more damage to Seapunk.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Seapunk had not intended to attack, I would have replaced Coral Guard with another Water's Edge for more damage.
